patterns.note: A four-quadrant split screen divided by organic, torn-paper edges that meet at a central focal point.
Scroll-bound zoom transition that scales the quadrants outward from the center, simulating an immersive entry into a deeper layer.
Muted, organic earth tones (terracotta, sage, dusty blue, and ochre) overlaid with a heavy tactile paper-grain texture.
Whimsical, rounded, hand-drawn display typography that reinforces the craft-oriented, DIY aesthetic.

technique_notes: To recreate the scroll-driven entry transition, bind the scroll delta to a scale and translation animation using a timeline library. As the user scrolls, scale the four quadrant containers outward from the central intersection point while fading in the underlying canvas or content layer.

Achieve the tactile paper look by applying a high-frequency SVG turbulence noise filter as a CSS overlay, combined with custom SVG path masks to create the irregular, fibrous 'torn' edges on the container borders.

design_tokens.type_scale: Uniform, friendly display sizes with heavy weights and generous letter-spacing to maintain readability on textured backgrounds.

standout: The interface completely eschews traditional digital layouts in favor of a tactile, physical 'papercraft' gateway. The use of scroll-jacking to physically 'part' the paper quadrants creates an immediate, magical sense of immersion.
